### Q&A

## Product Overview

The Blackwing 602 Short Pencils are compact, high-quality writing tools designed for those on the go. Perfect for sketching, note-taking, and even tallying golf scores, these pencils fit easily in your pocket or bag.

## Key Benefits

- Compact Size – Half the size of regular Blackwing pencils, perfect for travel.
- Firm Graphite Core – Provides a smooth writing experience.
- Unique Ferrule Design – Features a square ferrule with a pink eraser.
- Stylish Storage Box – Comes in a Blackwing storage box for easy transport.
- Set of 12 – Includes 12 mini pencils in each set.

## Who This Product Is Best For

The Blackwing 602 Short Pencils are ideal for artists, students, and professionals who need a portable writing solution. They're also great for golfers and anyone who enjoys sketching or taking notes on the go.

## Common Questions About This Product

### What is the length of each Blackwing 602 Short pencil?

Each pencil measures 4 3/10 inches in length.

### Are these pencils refillable or do they need to be replaced?

The Blackwing 602 Short pencils are not refillable; they need to be replaced once used up.

### What type of graphite is used in the Blackwing 602 Short pencils?

These pencils feature a firm graphite core, providing a high-quality writing experience.

## Buying Considerations

When choosing the Blackwing 602 Short Pencils, consider their compact size and intended use. They're perfect for travel and sketching, making them a great choice for artists and students alike.

Blackwing creates thoughtfully designed products to spark inspiration. Their mission is to empower people with the tools and education to express their creativity, even at an early age. Overtime, Blackwing went from a pencil to an icon. Blackwing pencils have since been re-introduced to a new generation of writers, artists, and makers.

## Product description

# Tools Coveted By Award-winning Creators 

 Pencils, sharpeners and notebooks for writers, artists, composers and anyone who does their best thinking with a pencil in hand. Genuine California Incense-cedar. Japanese graphite. The iconic ferrule that has been our signature for ninety years. 

# Built on Heritage 

 Blackwing's roots go back to the 1930s, when it was the pencil of choice for creators including John Steinbeck and Chuck Jones. The brand disappeared in the 1990s and returned in 2010. Today Blackwing crafts pencils, notebooks and analog tools for people who want to slow down. 

- I'm new to Blackwing. Which pencil should I start with? 

 Most people start with the Pearl - it sits between the soft Matte and the firm 602. To try all four cores before committing to a dozen, the Pencil Essentials Set includes one of each. 
- What do soft, firm, balanced and extra-firm actually mean? 

 They describe how much graphite the pencil lays down and how long it holds a point. Softer cores make darker lines and need sharpening more often. Firmer cores make finer lines and last longer between sharpenings. 
- Will Blackwing pencils fit a standard sharpener? 

 Yes. The barrel is a standard pencil diameter. The Blackwing One-Step and Two-Step sharpeners are shaped to produce the long, curved point these pencils are designed around. 
- Why is the eraser rectangular instead of round? 

 The flat eraser slides out of the ferrule so you can extend it as it wears, then replace it when it is gone. It has been Blackwing's signature since the 1930s. 
- What is the Blackwing Foundation? 

 A portion of every purchase funds the Blackwing Foundation, which supports arts and music education in public schools.

# Blackwing 602 (Short) - Box of 12 Pencils
Sold by: fredaldous.co.uk

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 32 GBP.

## Description
The Blackwing 602 Short Pencils are a compact version of the iconic Blackwing 602, renowned for their smooth writing experience and timeless design.Crafted with the same high-quality graphite formulation as the original, these short pencils offer the classic Blackwing performance in a portable size. Measuring approximately half the length of standard pencils, they're ideal for on-the-go use, fitting comfortably into pockets, notebooks, or travel cases. The pencils feature the distinctive grey finish and replaceable erasers, maintaining the brand's signature aesthetic.Key Features Material – Premium graphite core encased in genuine incense cedar wood Dimensions – Approximately half the length of standard Blackwing 602 pencils Design – Classic grey finish with replaceable erasers Portability – Compact size ideal for travel and on-the-go use Performance – Smooth writing experience with balanced graphite hardness The Blackwing 602 Short Pencils combine the exceptional quality of the original Blackwing 602 with enhanced portability, making them a perfect choice for artists, writers, and professionals seeking a compact writing instrument.
